emails.subject: Re: Congratulations on the BIFA apprentice award
emails.html:
Hello,

Last week I wrote to you about Kazinga and the time that routine rate requests can take away from developing people at Avocet Clearance. It uses AI to read each incoming request, prices it from your own tariffs and margin, and drafts the reply for your team to check and send. Your data is stored in the EU and encrypted, and Tiph cannot read it.

Would a 20-minute demo in English over the next couple of weeks be useful?

Kind regards,
